items.title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
items.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman agrees with safety concerns regarding AI development, says no initial share sale this year.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Revolut says customer data exposed through fake government email
items.snippet: Passports, selfies and financial transaction histories of some customers were revealed to a fraudster using a government agency domain.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
